name: AppRole
description: Application-defined role for fine-grained authorization within a tenant (e.g., 'editor', 'reviewer'). Assigned to users via UserToAppRoleToTenant. ACL is admin-read only: role definitions are managed at deploy time or through dedicated /admin endpoints.

attributes.name: canSignUp
attributes.description: Onboarding policy, populated from the OnboardingMatrix on deploy. Whether a self-service signup may request this role. Nullable; read null as false (deny).

attributes.name: canBeInvited
attributes.description: Onboarding policy, populated from the OnboardingMatrix on deploy. Whether an admin may invite a user into this role. Nullable; read null as false (deny).

attributes.name: requiresApproval
attributes.description: Onboarding policy, populated from the OnboardingMatrix on deploy. Whether signup/invite into this role needs admin approval before activation. Nullable; read null as true (safe).
